name: resource_lock_contention
boundary: two daemons for one project, and a stale lock left by a dead one
seed_method: a real session brings the first daemon up; a second `qompack daemon` is run against the same project in the foreground; then the lock is rewritten to name a dead pid
reason: exactly one daemon held the lock, the second exited 0 without touching the project, hooks delivered during the contention exited 0, and a stale lock was reclaimed by the next daemon
